name: Lurie Children's — Main Hospital
aliases: Ann Robert H Lurie Childrens Hospital of Chicago

options.name: Huron-Superior Parking Garage A
options.instructions: Use the Huron Street entrance. Take the elevator to the second floor and follow signs for the pedestrian bridge to Lurie Children's. Bring your parking ticket to the second-floor concierge desk for validation.

options.name: Erie-Ontario Garage — alternate option
options.instructions: Lurie lists this garage a few blocks from the main hospital as another parking option. Ticket validation is available at the hospital's second-floor concierge desk.

name: Lurie Children's — Outpatient Center in Lincoln Park
address: 2515 N. Clark Street / 467 W. Deming Place, Chicago, IL 60614

options.name: Lincoln Park self parking
options.instructions: Lurie lists paid self parking at 2515 N. Clark Street. The center uses Clark and Deming buildings; check which building is on your appointment. Check the official page for current parking rates.

name: Lurie Children's — Outpatient Center in Northbrook

options.name: Outpatient Center on-site parking
options.instructions: Lurie lists free on-site parking. The Surgery Center is next door at 1121 Techny Road, so confirm your appointment's building number.

name: Lurie Children's — Surgery Center in Northbrook

options.name: Surgery Center adjacent lot
options.instructions: Lurie's procedure guide lists free parking in the adjacent lot at the Northbrook Surgery Center. Confirm 1121 Techny Road on your appointment; the Outpatient Center is next door at 1131.

name: Lurie Children's — Outpatient Center in Skokie

options.name: Outpatient Center adjacent lot
options.instructions: Lurie lists free parking in the adjacent lot at this Outpatient Center.

name: Lurie Children's — Outpatient Center in Westchester

options.name: Outpatient Center on-site parking
options.instructions: Lurie lists on-site parking at this location. The nearby Westbrook rehabilitation location has a different address; confirm your appointment is at 2301 Enterprise Drive.
